id: title:jose-sequeira:surface batch splits in debug api and control plane ui

review.posthog_relevance: Adds structured debugging and observability for batch-splitting behavior in the ingestion control-plane, allowing PostHog engineers to record and inspect reasons and message counts when batches are split, aiding ingestion reliability and debugging.
review.reason: The change adds a `SendSplit` variant to `DebugEventKind` and records message totals and split reasons. This is a localized, bounded implementation of a debugging and observability feature. It does not demonstrate broader systemic risk reduction or adoption, nor does it change query correctness or user-facing behavior. The tier is assigned based on the visible implementation of a 1
review.uncertainty: The tier assignment relies on the supplied observations; no independent verification of actual production benefit, incident avoidance, or adoption is available. The score does not account for unverified outcomes or the number of PRs.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No tier assignment performed.
